tests: Game loads without errors
All assets (symbols, backgrounds) loaded correctly
Sound assets loaded, no audio glitches on startup
Loading screen / progress bar displays correctly
Spin button triggers a spin
Reel animation plays correctly
Win line highlights display correctly
Win amount calculated and displayed correctly
Balance updates after each spin (debit & credit)
Paytable opens and shows correct values
Bet level / coin value can be changed
Min and max bet limits are enforced
Total bet displayed correctly after change
Max Bet button sets highest available bet
Autoplay starts with selected number of spins
Autoplay stops at 0 remaining spins
Stop on feature win setting works
Stop on loss limit setting works
Autoplay can be manually stopped mid-session
Bonus game / free spins trigger on correct scatter count
Free spins counter shows correct remaining count
Free spins winnings accumulate correctly
Bonus game ends and returns to base game
Retriggering free spins works (if applicable)
Win animation and sound play on win
Big Win / Mega Win celebration triggers correctly
Info / Help screen opens and closes
Game rules and RTP displayed correctly
No overlapping UI elements or layout breaks
Reality check / session reminder triggers on time
Game history accessible and correct
